attempted_claim: Let xbar in pi_4(BGl_1(S)) ~= Z/24 generate the 3-torsion, x:M(Z/3,4) -> BGl_1(S) extend xbar, m > 8, M^m a closed stably framed smooth m-manifold with f:M -> M(Z/3,4) an isomorphism on pi_4, k >= 5 so that -xf lifts to BAut_*(S^k), pi:E -> M the associated spherical fibration with fibre S^k, and d = m+k >= 6. Then E is a finite simply connected oriented d-dimensional Poincare complex with vanishing periodic total surgery obstruction but non-reducible Spivak normal fibration (Hebestreit-Land-Weiss-Winges, arXiv:2406.14677v2 Main Theorem). Is this E homotopy equivalent to a closed ANR homology manifold of dimension d?
decisive_failure: The lane verified the blockage against the full HLWW v2 text (pp.1-17): both decisive routes presuppose one side of a documented published incompatibility (BFMW96 vs FP95 Theorem 16.6), the BFMW24 erratum confirms the proof defect, no independent Quinn/assembly/ko invariant decides the case, and the patch/fibrewise recovery needs an unproven sufficiency theorem. No original theorem or invariant was produced.
